Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The PR changes the wire gouge check. I reviewed the laws from current upstream main, 5a77703b5. The local trial merge was clean.

What looks good:

- The new tests check punch, die, open-run, and outside-centre readings against known depths.
- The two call sites use the same signed distance function.
- No goldens, UI files, fixtures, importers, dependencies, or process files changed.

Results merged with main, locally:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Passed: 7 steps, 0 failed |
| sim lib | 230 passed |
| app `solid_law_goldens` | 7 passed |
| app `wire_burnout` | 3 passed |
| app `wire_tabs` | 4 passed |
| app `wire_taper` | 10 passed |
| app `wire_verify` | 3 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

Extra suites run:

- `wire_verify_tol::a_tessellated_loft_posts_under_its_chord_tolerance_and_is_refused_below_it`: passed.
- The extra fixture and importer rules select no additional suites for this diff.

Mutations repeated locally:

- Changed the `kerf.rs` call back to `clearance`: the open-run test failed. Restored it: all 4 depth tests passed.
- Changed the `passes.rs` call back to `clearance`: the punch and die tests failed. Restored it: all 4 depth tests passed.
- No goldens moved. There were no golden lines to compare.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/sim/src/verify/wire/dist.rs:105`: Refine every interval that can contain a deeper entry. The present search can miss the entire inside portion. I tested a move from `(0, 0)` to `(100, 0)` through a square with X bounds `[50.5625, 52.5625]` and Y bounds `[-1, 1]`. Each coarse sample is outside. The coarse result keeps `t0 = 0`, so the fine search covers only the start of the move. `entry` returns 0, although the true signed entry is -1 mm. With a 0.162 mm kerf, the reported depth remains 0.162 mm instead of 1.162 mm. This reproduces the defect that this PR must fix. The 1 mm error also exceeds the stated bound of `100 / 1024 = 0.09765625` mm. Add this regression test and correct the bound in `docs/decisions/3211-wire-gouge-depth.md:17` and the PR body. A temporary local test failed with this output:

   ```text
   expected signed depth -1 within claimed error 0.09765625; got 0 at Point2 { x: 50.5625, y: 0.0 }
   test result: FAILED. 0 passed; 1 failed
   ```

2. `crates/sim/src/verify/wire/dist.rs:85` / PR body, Tests: Supply the required heavy-lane results for the final head. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` reaches both app and motion heavy lanes. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, “Heavy lanes at review”, requires these runs before the PR is ready. The body names only quick checks and clippy. I ran the heavy plan only; I did not run the heavy tests. Run the reached lanes and record their results. An unrun lane is not a pass.

Notes:

- The counterexample still blocks the cut. This finding concerns the reported depth.
- I restored all temporary mutations and removed the temporary regression test. I changed no PR code and pushed nothing.
- No GitHub runner or workflow was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. The signed-entry search now refines every inside interval that can contain a deeper entry. Product and stock crossings split the move. The decision record and PR body now state the maximum underestimation bound. Tests: `an_inside_interval_between_coarse_samples_reports_its_full_depth` and `a_stock_limited_die_entry_keeps_the_bound_at_the_stock_edge`. Both fail with the old search. All six depth tests pass with the fix restored.
2. Both reached heavy lanes ran on the final head. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` passed: 236 steps, 0 failed. Motion: 59 passed, with two expected failures. App: 43 passed, with four expected failures. The gate checked the exact known assertions for #1950 and #2849. No unexpected test failed. The PR body records these results.

Quick gate: 7 steps, 0 failed. Clippy for all camcraft-sim targets passed with warnings denied. No golden files changed.

New head: `c7acb5301e32e1b59ed80ea741cd6931f0abc815`.

Please re-review this head.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The PR changes the wire gouge check. I checked the laws from current upstream main, `6ffa808ae`. The local trial merge was clean. No GitHub runner or workflow was used.

What looks good:

- The search splits moves at product and stock boundaries. It checks each inside interval with a distance bound.
- The new regression tests cover the missed interval and the stock boundary from the earlier review.
- The decision record and PR body now state the maximum depth underestimation, with floating-point roundoff excluded.
- No goldens moved. There were no changed golden lines to compare.
- No UI, fixtures, importers, dependencies, or process files changed.

Results merged with main, locally:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Passed: 7 steps, 0 failed |
| sim lib | 232 passed |
| app `solid_law_goldens` | 7 passed |
| app `wire_burnout` | 3 passed |
| app `wire_tabs` | 4 passed |
| app `wire_taper` | 10 passed |
| app `wire_verify` | 3 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | Passed: 3 steps, 0 failed; both light tests passed |

Extra suites run:

- `wire_verify_tol::a_tessellated_loft_posts_under_its_chord_tolerance_and_is_refused_below_it`: passed.
- All six `verify::wire::depth_tests` passed after restoration of the mutations.
- The extra fixture and importer rules select no additional suites for this diff.

Mutations repeated locally:

- Changed the `kerf.rs` call back to `clearance`: the open-run depth test failed. Five other depth tests passed.
- Changed the `passes.rs` call back to `clearance`: the punch and die depth tests failed. Four other depth tests passed.
- Restored both calls: all six depth tests passed. No source changes remain in the review worktree.

Earlier findings:

1. Met. The revised search checks every inside interval. Both new regression tests passed locally. The stated bound now describes underestimation.
2. Met. The author records both reached heavy lanes on this exact head. Motion: 59 passed, with two expected failures. App: 43 passed, with four expected failures. The author reports 236 gate steps and no unexpected failure. The gate checked the expected assertions for #1950 and #2849. These six expected failures are exceptions, not passing tests. I checked the heavy plan locally. I did not repeat the full heavy run.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

- With a nonzero verify tolerance, the signed depth can make the check more restrictive. The body's statement that the verdict never changes is too broad. This is consistent with correcting the depth used by the tolerance check.
- The depth can underestimate the maximum by move length / 1024, apart from floating-point roundoff. This limit is now explicit.
- A real lofted STEP part through MCP was not exercised.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Coordinator: this PR merges by the maintainer's standing order of 2026-11-21 ("merge using the recommended option"). The review that this merge relies on is the collaborator `pr-reviewer` marker on head c7acb5301 (clean). The head has no commits after that review, and the PR merges cleanly with `main`. I merge it on head c7acb5301. It is a fork PR, so its branch stays.
